title: Persatrix Optimization Configuration
description: Schema for config/optimization.yaml. RFC 0034 Phase 1 PR 2 introduced this schema scoped to the top-level `conversation_window` block; RFC 0023 PR 2 adds the top-level `wallet` block (LLM-call leasing lease-lifecycle tuning); RFC 0033 Phase 1 PR 1 adds the top-level `models.aliases` block (provider-agnostic model alias map). The Go orchestrator owns the model-routing / caching / cost-budget surface end-to-end, so those keys are intentionally left unconstrained (top-level additionalProperties defaults to true) rather than duplicating the orchestrator's optimisation schema in two places. Future RFCs may grow this schema.

schema_version.description: Optimization-config schema version. RFC 0033 Phase 1 bumped this from "0.1" to "0.2" when the `models.aliases` block landed; Phase 3 (raw-ID rejection) bumped it to "0.3" — model identity now flows exclusively through `models.aliases` (a raw vendor model ID is rejected at resolve, not prefix-inferred), and the `default.model_routing.provider_inference` block is retired.

models.description: RFC 0033 — Provider-Agnostic Model Alias Layer. Houses the alias map: the single source of truth for model identity, sitting at the top level alongside `default` / `cost` (not profile-scoped). A vendor retirement or provider swap is a one-line edit to one alias entry.

aliases.description: Logical alias (`quality` / `fast` / `summarizer`) → concrete (provider, model, pricing) record. Agents and routing defaults reference these names instead of vendor model IDs. Resolved by agents/model_aliases.py.

additionalProperties.description: One alias entry. Pricing is required on every entry so the alias-derived cost table (RFC 0033 §F, PR 5) stays complete; a local ($0-real) model carries an explicit 0 rather than omitting the fields.

provider.description: Provider routing key — e.g. `anthropic`, `openai`, `ollama`, `mock`. The alias entry's `provider` is authoritative; provider is data, not inferred (RFC 0033 §H).

model.description: Physical vendor model ID used in the API call — the value the alias name resolves to.

input_per_1m_tokens.description: Input-token price per 1M tokens (USD). 0 for a $0-real local model (documented $0, not absent).

output_per_1m_tokens.description: Output-token price per 1M tokens (USD). 0 for a $0-real local model.

provider_config.description: Provider-specific passthrough settings — e.g. `base_url` for an OpenAI-compatible local endpoint. Alias-level values are authoritative; an agent entry's provider_config fills only the gaps (RFC 0033 §D precedence rule 2).

notes.description: Free-text annotation — e.g. the local-pricing decision for a $0-real entry. Documentation only.

wallet.description: RFC 0023 — LLM Call Leasing: server-side lease-lifecycle tuning for the orchestrator's WalletService. Top-level block (sibling of `cost:`), parsed by the Go orchestrator. An absent block — or an absent key — falls back to the defaults below.

ttl_seconds.description: Lease time-to-live in seconds. The reaper settles a lease still unsettled this long after issue at its granted (worst-case) amount. Default 60 = 2× the 30 s default per-call timeout (RFC 0023 Open Question §2). The 86400 (1 day) maximum is a fat-finger guard and keeps the value within the int32 LeaseGrant.ttl_seconds advertised on the wire.

reaper_interval_seconds.description: How often, in seconds, the reaper scans for leases left unsettled past their TTL. The 3600 (1 hour) maximum is a fat-finger guard — a scan cadence slower than this cannot meaningfully bound the in-flight lease map.

max_active_leases.description: Per-agent cap on concurrently-held (unsettled) leases — a DoS ceiling (RFC 0023 Security Considerations), keyed on the lease-issuing agent. The 1024 (64× default) maximum is a fat-finger guard — a value beyond it defeats the ceiling's purpose.

conversation_window.description: RFC 0034 Phase 1: top-level defaults for the persona conversation-window transcript reconstruction. NOT a profile block — these apply regardless of `active_profile`. Per-agent overrides live under each agent's `conversation_window` block in config/agents.yaml; an omitted per-agent block inherits these values.

enabled.description: Whether the persona runtime reconstructs the conversation window. false ⇒ the LLM `messages` array is seeded with the current event only (pre-RFC-0034 behaviour).

max_turns.description: Upper bound on replayed transcript turns. Oldest turns drop first (FIFO) once the count is exceeded (RFC 0034 OQ #2 resolution 2a).

max_tokens.description: Token budget for the replayed transcript, separate from the RFC 0017 system-prompt memory budget. Oldest turns drop first (FIFO) once the budget is exceeded; the tighter of max_turns / max_tokens binds per turn.
